user.title: Connect to MowgliNext
user.description: Enter the MQTT topic prefix mqtt_bridge_node publishes on (default "mowgli" — see docs/MQTT_CONTROL.md in the mowglinext repo). The broker itself is configured once in Home Assistant's own MQTT integration, not here.

abort.mqtt_not_configured: Set up the MQTT integration first (Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → MQTT).
abort.already_configured: This topic prefix is already configured.
